name: Arch-Revenant
abilities:
Fight And Fly: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit If this unit charged this turn, this unit can move up to 2D6" after that Fight ability has been resolved. It cannot end that move in combat.
Gossamid Commander: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible friendly Gossamid Archers unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target. The target can immediately use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of the attacks made as part of that Shoot ability must target an enemy unit that is in combat with this unit.

name: Belthanos, First Thorn of Kurnoth
abilities:
Huntmaster's Strike: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn If this unit charged this turn, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6" from all enemy units and wholly within the creeping overgrowth.
Kurnothi War-horn: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly Kurnothi units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Rhythm of the Chase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll, then you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield within 1" of the target.
Keywords: Rampage
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Carnelian Greatspite's Mandibles is 3.

name: Branchwych
abilities: Slay The Trespassers!: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick an enemy unit that is within the creeping overgrowth or that is visible to this unit and within friendly territory to be the target. Rolla dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

name: Drycha Hamadreth
abilities:
Terror Of The Deep Woods: Enemy units cannot use Run or Retreat abilities while they are within 9" of this unit.
Enrage The Spites: Your Hero Phase Pick up to 3 enemy units that are visible to and within 12" of this unit or that are within the creeping overgrowth to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
Keywords: Spell
Merciless Ambush: Your Charge Phase If this unit is not in combat and has not used a Run or Retreat ability this turn, make a charge roll of 2D6. You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1/2" of an enemy unit and wholly within X" of a terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token, where X is equal to the charge roll. If you do so, this unit has charged.
Keywords: Core, Move, Charge, Rampage

name: Spirit of Durthu
abilities:
Groundshaker: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy non-Fly Infantry or Cavalry unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice, On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Rampage
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Guardian Sword is 3.
Guardian Of The Glades: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Charge ability for this unit Add 2 to the charge roll but this unit must end that charge move within 1/2" of an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly Sylvaneth Hero.

name: The Lady of Vines
abilities:
Verdian Crown: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit that does not have a friendly overgrown token to be the target. Give the target a friendly overgrown token
Protection Of The Everqueen: Your Hero Phase Make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within the creeping overgrowth. Until the start of your next turn, friendly Sylvaneth units have Ward (5+) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Keywords: Spell
Hands Of The Everqueen: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit that has a friendly overgrown token to be the target. The next time this unit uses a non-Summon Spell ability this phase, when picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from the target terrain feature instead of from this unit, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to the target terrain feature instead of to this unit for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.
Keywords: Rampage

name: Treelord
abilities:
Strangling Grasp: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
Keywords: Rampage
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Sweeping Blows is 3.
Lash And Tangle: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's Strangleroots to be the target. Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is within the creeping overgrowth. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Treelord Ancient
abilities:
Eldest Of Elders: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick each friendly Forest Elder within this unit's combat range to be the targets. Roll a dice for each target, On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for that target's combat attack until the start of your next turn.
Keywords: Rampage
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Sweeping Blows is 3.

Then, pick a friendly non-Unique Kurnothi or Treelord unit that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit with 1 model from the target unit wholly within 6" of that terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, remove the friendly overgrown token from that terrain feature. If the target was a Treelord, allocate 10 damage points to the replacement unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

name: Warsong Revenant
abilities:
Wyldwood Revenants: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You made an unmodified chanting roll of 1 for a Sylvaneth Priest wholy within 12" of this unit. Re-roll that chanting roll.
Alarielle's Song: Friendly Sylvaneth units have Ward (6+) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

name: Battle Traits: Sylvaneth
abilities:
Endless Growth: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick each friendly Sylvaneth unit that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth to be the targets. For each target, roll a D3 and pick 1 of the following effects:


• Heal (X) the target, where X is equal to the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.
The Creeping Overgrowth: The creeping overgrowth is measured from each terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token. The range of the creeping overgrowth is based on the number of friendly, overgrown tokens on the battlefield as shown:

• 0-2 overgrown tokens: 6"
• 3-5 overgrown tokens: 9"
• 6-8 overgrown tokens: 12"
• 9+ overgrown tokens: Whole battlefield


*Designer's Note: Awakened Wyldwoods are your main way of generating overgrown tokens. Some unit abilities allow you to too.*
Fury of The Forest: Enemy Combat Phase Pick a friendly Sylvaneth unit wholly within the creeping overgrowth and that is in combat with only 1 enemy unit to use this ability. The unit using this ability has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.
The Land Awakens: End of Your Turn Pick a friendly non-Hero Revenant Infantry unit or friendly Dryads unit that has been destroyed to be the target. Setup a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.
Reclaimed By Nature: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase If there are fewer than 3 friendly Awakened Wyldwoods on the battlefield, you can set up an Awakened Wyldwood on the battlefield more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 12" from all other friendly Awakened Wyldwoods and more than 1" from all other terrain features.
Creeping Dread: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn Pick an enemy unit within the creeping overgrowth to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the first time your opponent declares a command for the target while it is not wholly within 12" of a Hero in their army, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as being used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

name: Dryads
abilities: One With The Forest: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth.

abilities:

name: Tree-Revenants
abilities: Waypiper's Dance: While this unit is in combat and has not charged this turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

abilities:

name: Ylthari's Guardians
abilities:

*Charge Through the Swarm:* Subtract 1 from hit rolls for that unit's attacks for the rest of the turn, and add 1 to hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

Seasons Of War: Start of Battle Round You must use this ability. Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle round. You cannot pick the effect that you picked in the previous battle round.


*The Burgeoning*: Each time a friendly Awakened Wyldwood uses the 'Ever Growing' ability, you can pick any terrain feature your opponent does not control to be the target rather than the closest.

*The Reaping*: Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for friendly Sylvaneth units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.


*The Dwindling*: Friendly Sylvaneth units can use Charge abilities even if they used a Retreat ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on those units when they use Retreat abilities.

*Everdusk*: Each time you use the 'Creeping Dread' ability this battle round, you can pick up to 3 targets instead of 1.
